name: JW Marriott Hotel Muscat
positioning: Hotel in Madinat Al Irfan, Airport Heights, Muscat, with three outdoor pools, the JW Garden and rooms that blend traditional Omani elements with contemporary comfort
best_for: Travelers who want a Muscat base about 10 minutes from the airport
Families who want a kids club, a kids' pool and family activities
Guests who want a pool, garden and spa stay in Muscat

facts.text: The hotel is in Madinat Al Irfan, Airport Heights, Muscat.
The hotel is about 10 minutes from Muscat International Airport.
Rooms and suites are designed to reflect the modern Omani lifestyle, blending traditional elements with contemporary comfort.
Some rooms and suites have wadi views.
Rooms feature bathtubs with rain showers and designer bath products.
Suites have spacious living areas, elegant bedrooms and marble-clad bathrooms.
The hotel has three outdoor swimming pools: a lap pool, an infinity pool and a kids' pool.
Spa by JW offers treatments designed to Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew, from massages to signature therapies.
The hotel has a tennis court and a fitness center with modern equipment and private classes.
The restaurants are Kitchen 7, Butter Buns, Pink Salt, Catch and JW Market.
Catch is a seafood restaurant in a garden setting right next to the pool.
The hotel is Green Key certified and certified LEED Gold by the U.S. Green Building Council.

highlights.text: The contemporary lap pool has city views.
Guests can walk around the lush JW Garden.
The Presidential Suite has an elegant living room, a spacious dining area and a balcony.
Family by JW offers creative workshops, nature classes and events for every age, plus a Kids Club and in-room games and guides.
Pink Salt steakhouse serves hand-picked cuts dry-aged for 30 and 40 days.

considerations.text: The nearest beach the hotel lists, Azaiba beach, is about 15 km away.
Muscat Hills Golf & Country Club is about 12 km from the hotel.
